apps.localizedDescription:
VortX:

The Android APK is an early technical preview, not the finished app. VortX is Apple first: the Apple TV, iPhone, iPad, and Mac apps are the complete experience today. Android is just getting started, sharing the same native engine, and the preview exists so Android users can watch the port take shape and help steer it. Expect missing features, rough edges, and fast-moving builds. If you want the full VortX experience right now, use the Apple apps; if you try the Android preview, please report what you hit, because every report shapes the port.

versions.localizedDescription:
0.4.0 Beta 21 - Profile sync, chosen-source binge playback, and recovery fixes:

This is a fresh release from current reviewed source, not an older beta checkout. It retains the working iPhone/iPad startup and touch-player fixes from Beta 20 and the earlier Android feature set. It uses the Latest beta channel while keeping its beta name.

What's fixed:

New profiles and profile edits can travel between your devices. Apple settings notifications previously kept restarting an outgoing-sync delay even when no real syncable setting changed. That could leave incoming peer changes waiting behind a pending push. Only genuine changes now schedule that push, and suppressed restore notifications cannot escape into a delayed task and re-arm it.

An older device cannot treat an unrelated push as a newer profile edit. Profile merges now carry the actual roster modification clock instead of losing it on the push-side merge. Equal-content pulls still adopt the valid peer watermark. Local edits strictly advance the clock even if the device clock moves backward; malformed clocks are rejected. Remote imports do not manufacture a new local editing time.

Apple and Android exchange the full roster; dashboard edits preserve other fields. Apple now reads and writes the full roster carrier used by Android as well as its settings carrier, reconciles them by their own clocks, and treats a lossy profile summary as missing-ID information rather than permission to clear full same-ID settings. Incomplete full carriers are rejected. Generic settings restoration no longer overwrites the roster or this device's active viewer before the profile merge runs.

Changing a profile is different from switching the viewer. The profile's shared properties sync. Which profile is selected stays local to each device, so a phone's selection does not unexpectedly switch the TV. These fixes require updated native clients as well as the deployed dashboard. They do not certify every broader library/Continue Watching sync path or migrate the pre-existing global roster clock into an account-specific schema.

A stalled preferred resolver cannot consume the whole episode handoff budget. Episode and batch selection use the same frozen candidate list. The complete resolution operation—including the local Usenet leg—is bounded, not just the TorBox cloud branch. Cancellation, replacement ownership and the caller's deadline are checked before using the result or enqueueing a download. Quality variants keep their supplying add-on instead of losing that identity along the route.

Batch downloads learn only a real accepted choice. A no-op because the episode is already queued, or a failed record, cannot replace the remembered series choice. Transfer retries continue after the accepted candidate without retrying already rejected candidates. This is chosen-release continuity, not a promise that every add-on exposes identical binge-group metadata or every provider link can resolve.

Playback errors stay errors instead of hiding an old stream behind them. Terminal failure retires asynchronous recovery and native AVPlayer activity. Later callbacks cannot remove the error overlay or restart the outgoing item. Retry keeps the episode that actually failed to resolve, including through timeout, duplicate and rejected-command cases, rather than silently using the episode last played successfully. The failed target is retired only after an accepted replacement.

A manual seek supersedes an old automatic resume. New viewer seek intent cancels obsolete initial-resume work so an old watchdog cannot later reinstall its previous target after the viewer has moved elsewhere. Timeline and resume-intent contracts cover this boundary. This is a specific state repair, not a claim that every source's nonzero-offset playback freeze is solved.

A requested mpv seek time is no longer mistaken for completed recovery. mpv can report its requested target before playback has restarted. Shared Apple seek accounting now carries source/generation-owned restart evidence, requires explicit non-seeking and non-EOF state, and revalidates queued callbacks before retiring a resume watchdog or completing paused recovery. An EOF-shaped restart or ambiguous overlapping command cannot certify completion. Paused and audio-only restart samples need no forced Play or advancing clock. Raw timeline feedback remains available. This is stronger restart/EOF accounting, not unconditional decoded-picture proof or a fix claim for the separate AIOStreams HTTP/VideoToolbox stall.

Exiting a preview belongs to the original playback session. Preview stop/close retains the original source, position and pause choice, and restores them only under the matching session owner. A stale preview completion cannot take over a newer source or episode.

Closing the skip editor saves your real position, not its preview. Preview return runs before progress/scrobble decisions. A same-media source or player change uses the original owned position; if the preview began while paused, the accepted replacement also stays paused. A new episode, newer Play action, rejected switch or obsolete mount cannot inherit that temporary handoff. Ordinary new playback retains its autoplay default.

Downloaded episodes resume from their own saved progress. iPhone, iPad and Mac now look up the download's library/episode identity instead of starting every completed file at zero or borrowing the detail page's resident title. The asynchronous lookup checks account ownership and the actual active profile before and after waiting, plus cancellation, the current completed record and the file's continued existence.

Mac has functional native window controls and one detail Back. The standard traffic-light controls are explicitly enabled and their titlebar container is placed above the content for interaction, while the hidden-titlebar/hidden-toolbar architecture is retained. The detail route suppresses the native Back item when it uses the custom app Back. This does not restore the old vertical sidebar or recreate the native toolbar that previously crashed.

Mac Search has a visible search field again. The dedicated page owns its glass search field, suggestions, clear and keyboard-submit actions. The global search popover remains a shortcut rather than replacing the page's main control; the crashing native-toolbar search route is not reintroduced.

Seek diagnostics distinguish accepted boundaries from ambiguous old events. The Mac mpv witness checks the recovery policy's accepted phase before attributing the event to a current resume target. A delayed event from a superseded seek is no longer labelled as proof that the newer seek began. The standalone credential compiler harness also follows current real policy dependencies in normal and generated fixtures, while retaining its eight credential/owner/root-integrity gates.

Android:

This beta includes both distribution variants. Each APK serves phones and Android TV and includes arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64; the filenames describe the engine, not a phone/TV split.

• VortX-0.4.0-full-mpv-universal.apk: sideloaded MPV build with Media3 fallback.
• VortX-0.4.0-play-media3-universal.apk: Media3 build without GPL-native player libraries.
• VortX-0.4.0-play-media3.aab: matching distribution bundle, not an installable APK.

Android TV can actually use next-episode preloading and automatic advance. Its player host now wires the same halfway prewarm policy, ended callback and binge-prompt counter as the phone host. The continuation belongs to the profile and ViewModel that mounted the file: an owner change cannot launch another viewer's selected episode, and a preference-driven ViewModel rebuild does not unnecessarily stop healthy playback.

The Android profile and TV binge repairs are new in this release. They do not establish complete Apple-style appearance, full feature parity, or physical Shield/Fire TV playback acceptance.

Verification and remaining limits:

Release publication separately requires exact tagged source, fresh packages, Apple launch/package checks, both native engines and their callable ABI exports, Android production signing and packaged versions, checksums, immutable artifact provenance and public update-feed verification. Source tests and build success are not physical cross-device acceptance.

Please test:

• Create a profile on one updated device, then check another signed into the same VortX account. Change its name/avatar and preferences from the app and dashboard, then confirm the changes arrive without restarting or shuffling the roster. Keep each device's chosen viewer local.
• Edit a profile that has its own account, PIN or discovery settings; changing a name must not clear unrelated properties. Delete a test profile and confirm it does not return from an older device snapshot.

• Resume, manually seek elsewhere, and wait beyond the previous watchdog interval. The old resume target must not take over again. Exit a preview and check the original position and pause choice.

• Fail an episode resolution, then Retry: it must target the failed episode, keep a useful error and avoid restarting the outgoing item under that error.
• On Mac, check close/minimize/zoom, the single detail Back and the visible Search field. On Android TV, check automatic advance and Next from Continue Watching, then press Back during a slow source assembly and confirm playback does not reopen. On Android, create/edit profiles from the dashboard and compare the resulting 4K preference.
• Export diagnostics promptly if playback remains blank, stalled or starts at the wrong point, including build, episode, add-on/provider and preceding action.

Install:

The Apple IPAs are unsigned distribution packages and must be re-signed through your usual sideloading/signing service. The Mac package has its own ad-hoc signature, described below.

Apple TV. Use VortX-tvOS-v0.4.0-beta.21-ci.ipa for Full or VortX-tvOS-lite-v0.4.0-beta.21-ci.ipa for Lite through your usual signing service.

Android. Install the signed APK for the engine you want. Signer/provenance evidence is in SIGNING_PROVENANCE.txt; Android and Apple checksum manifests accompany the packages.

The public release and the AltStore / SideStore source are updated only after the protected publication gates pass. Actual in-app notification delivery on each installed device remains a device-level check.

apps.name: Hotline Navigator
apps.subtitle: Official Website
apps.localizedDescription:
Hotline Navigator:

Official Website.

What the hell is Hotline?:

Hotline in concept, was to replicate a BBS but for the internet age. Modern users would recongize more as a proto peer-to-peer or a Discord like application.

Hotline's Navigator's website has a deeper drive the history of Hotline.

Platform Support:

Right now the iOS, iPadOS, and Android versions are not in their respective app stores and must be built manually or sideloaded.

This is a Tauri-based Hotline client that provides a modern, cross-platform experience for the classic Hotline protocol. Built with React and Rust, it offers:

• Cross-Platform: Single codebase for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, iPadOS, and Android.
• Modern Stack: React + TypeScript frontend, Rust backend.

• Native Performance: Tauri's lightweight architecture for fast, efficient apps.

versions.localizedDescription:
v0.2.8:

There's been a lot of rapid changes in Navigator's capabilities so this release UX quality-of-life series of fixes since the Discord style chat introduced a new UX paradigm which inevitable had some loose ends.

Disconnects are detected in seconds instead of minutes, chat icons no longer fall back to gray letter placeholders for emotes or for users who chatted before their info loaded, and! / / commands now appear above the bot's response instead of below it. News browsing also works on multi-tier servers like VesperNet, where top-level entries are folders of folders.

Next release will be new feature bound.

Bugfixes and Improvements:

• Faster disconnect detection — When a server vanishes silently (peer crash, network drop, NAT timeout), the client now notices in ~60s on macOS/Linux and ~130s on Windows, down from the OS TCP retransmit default of 15+ minutes. Auto-reconnect kicks in correspondingly faster.

• News browsing on nested servers — On servers like VesperNet where the top-level news entries are folders containing more folders, navigation no longer dead-ends with an empty article pane. The client now dispatches based on the clicked item's actual type (bundle vs. category) rather than assuming any non-root path holds articles.

Technical:

• TCP SO_KEEPALIVE configured on the control channel via socket2: idle=30s, interval=10s, retries=3 on macOS/Linux. Windows uses the OS default retry count.
• App-level keepalive failure now emits StatusChanged(Disconnected) and clears the transport, instead of silently breaking.

• Optimistic insert tagged with pending: true and optimisticKey; echo dedup matches by userName + message text within a 10s window. /me and /em are preformatted as *** name action to match the server echo. 30s safety timeout clears the pending flag if no echo arrives.
• News load effect dispatches on a tracked newsLeafType (2 = bundle → get_news_categories; 3 = category → get_news_articles). Going back always sets leaf type to bundle, since non-leaf path segments are bundles by invariant.

Download the installer for your platform from the release assets.

.dmg = macOS, .msi/.exe = Windows, .apk = Android, .ipa = iOS/iPadOS, Linux hippies can figure it out.

apps.localizedDescription:

A playful emulator for iOS. It plays supported 32-bit iPhone games on modern iPhones — no jailbreak required, though JIT is. It installs and runs on iPadOS too, but every game runs as an iPhone guest for now: the core's iPad device families are not yet reachable from the app.

The emulation is entirely the work of touchHLE and its fork HyperHLE; this project is the iOS app built around them — the interface, the build system and the packaging. Neither project is connected to Applesauce or endorses it, so please report problems here rather than to them. No games or Apple software are included.

versions.localizedDescription:
Applesauce 0.4.1:

This update improves the library, game-session cleanup and AltStore Classic distribution. It keeps the same bundle identifier as 0.4.0, so it updates an existing Applesauce installation and retains its library and saves.

In AltStore Classic, open Sources → + and add:

Choose Applesauce from the source. Future releases appear in AltStore; you do not have to download a new IPA manually each time. Signing, refresh and JIT requirements still apply. The source does not enable JIT automatically.

Full installation and JIT guide.

Fixes:

• Importing copies files away from the main UI thread and coordinates access with Files providers such as iCloud Drive. A failed copy is cleaned up before it can appear as a partially imported game.
• Repeated taps cannot queue overlapping game launches. Library reloads are also suppressed while a game or import is active.
• Malformed game metadata that causes the HyperHLE parser to panic is caught at the native bridge. The library uses this parser regardless of the chosen gameplay core and falls back to a filename when metadata is unreadable.
• The FPS timer no longer retains the game-controls screen after exiting.
• The exit button respects the screen's safe area, and returning to the library uses the iOS 15 orientation fallback too.

• Building a second core copies only that core, avoiding accidental overwrite of a newer core with a stale file from another checkout.

• Migration instructions include saves and correctly explain which settings need to be reselected.

The AltStore source is checked against the unsigned IPA's version, build, minimum iOS, size, checksum and permissions. A release workflow updates the source for future published releases; prereleases and TrollStore packages are excluded from that automatic update.

Downloads:

• Applesauce-iOS-unsigned.ipa: AltStore Classic and other ordinary sideloaders.

The emulator versions remain HyperHLE v1.0.6 and touchHLE 0.2.3. This release does not claim additional game compatibility or fix the known Sims Medieval.

fresh device regression testing of 0.4.1 is still needed.

XeniOS is an experimental Apple-focused fork of Xenia, currently based on Xenia Edge. It exists as a fast-moving place to develop, test, and ship iOS and macOS work while also carrying platform changes that benefit ARM64 Windows, Linux, and Android. Relevant improvements are intended to flow back upstream over time.

Current Focus:

• macOS (Apple Silicon).
• macOS (Intel).

Current published releases focus on iOS and macOS. For Windows or Linux builds, use Xenia Edge or Xenia Canary.

apps.name: MiruShin
apps.subtitle: Your anime, movies, and shows: discover, track, and watch in one beautiful app
apps.localizedDescription:
What You Can Do:

More goodies.

• 📺 Android TV with remote-friendly navigation throughout.
• 🖼️ Picture-in-Picture and native player handoff where the platform supports it.
• 🔐 Host-controlled watch-party permissions for guest play/pause, seek, and speed changes.

• 🔄 Tracker sync for AniList, MyAnimeList, and Shikimori account workflows.
• 🔐 Per-account workspaces so switching AniList accounts also switches that account's Local Library and MAL/Shikimori connections.
• 📤 Exports to MyAnimeList XML and Shikimori JSON.
• 🧩 Add-ons (Sora-compatible modules) for source search, installable by URL.

Download:

Windows: the .exe installer is unsigned, so Microsoft Defender may show a false-positive warning. If that happens, use the .msi installer or the portable .zip instead.

versions.localizedDescription:
MiruShin continues to evolve as a modern and comfortable way to watch and discover media, with each update focused on making the experience smoother, cleaner, and more enjoyable across the app.

What's New:

• Keep library progress and status unchanged when Auto Progress is disabled, while preserving playback resume positions.
• Restore shared episode progress from Google Drive and protect intentional resets from stale legacy checkpoints.
• Improve playback responsiveness with progressive proxy streaming and request-isolated retries.
• Reduce player UI rebuilds, repeated FVP metadata reads, and playback checkpoint overhead.
• Correct buffer range reporting and preserve existing seek, startup, and fallback behavior.

v2.9.13:

• Fixed a macOS shutdown bug where closing the window could leave MiruShin running or crash on Quit.
• Closing MiruShin now waits for the final playback checkpoint, background tasks, and all library databases before shutting down Flutter.
• Interrupted tracker deliveries remain queued and are checked before retrying on the next launch.

v2.9.12:

• Fixed cross-device status, score, and Favorite inconsistencies; Library cards and Edit now read the same canonical local state.
• Prevented stale provider previews, background queue writes, and rounded tracker scores from overwriting newer local changes.
• Isolated per-episode checkpoint revisions and deduplicated false sync conflicts while preserving genuine concurrent edits.
• Added safe, history-backed recovery for legacy library inconsistencies and 36 regression tests.
• Improved reactive local-library updates and avoided redundant no-op database writes.

v2.9.11:

• Restore fresh Google Drive Library changes before tracker sync on another device.
• Preserve Updated sorting and safely resolve cross-device conflicts.
• Keep delete/re-add operations ordered, and show clearer sync status.

v2.9.10:

• Local Library stays responsive while Google Drive restores data.
• Google Drive sync uploads small changes without rebuilding the full backup after every edit.
• Reduced backup processing on the UI thread and improved sync progress and counts.

v2.9.9:

• Fixed direct-media playback through the local proxy without requesting signed streams twice.
• Reuse a proven playback route for the next episode while keeping fallbacks.
• Redacted signed media URLs from player diagnostics.

v2.9.8:

• Fixed Google Drive Sync getting stuck after uploading local changes when a tracker API is unavailable.
• Improved sync progress, retry handling, and background storage-size refresh.
• Added details and a safe Ignore option for Library entries with unavailable metadata.

v2.9.7:

• Faster cross-device Library sync: recent Google Drive changes arrive before tracker reconciliation, without duplicate uploads from the receiving device.
• AniList, MAL and Shikimori now deliver rapid delete and re-add actions in order, with independent retries and safer confirmation after failures.
• Completing anime fills the known episode total and finish date together; unknown totals are requested explicitly.
• Reduced unnecessary Google Drive backups and improved sync progress reporting.

v2.9.6:

• Fixed Google Drive Library Sync convergence across new and existing devices.
• Devices now pull snapshots and immutable operations independently of the delivery lease.
• Added safe recovery for missed progress, additions, and removals without overwriting concurrent local edits.

• Improved sync progress counts and partial-sync messages in English, Russian, and Japanese.

v2.9.5:

• Fixed video freezing while audio continued by restoring MediaKit/mpv platform-tested frame-dropping and A/V-sync defaults.

v2.9.4:

• Restored native Google Drive sign-in on iPhone, iPad, and Android phones/tablets.
• Kept the secure Cloudflare Worker browser flow as a fallback for re-signed, LiveContainer, TrollStore, jailbreak, and Android TV installations.
• Added regression tests for platform-specific Google Drive login routing.

v2.9.3:

• Rebuilt Local Library as an offline-first source of truth with separate AniList account workspaces and safer AniList, MyAnimeList, and Shikimori reconciliation.
• Expanded Google Drive Sync for complete library metadata, settings, addons, connections, playback state, and faster cross-device restoration.
• Fixed repeated Google Drive synchronization when nothing changed, improved pending and progress states, and made real local changes upload promptly.
• Added AniList outage fallbacks and cache-first Board, Discovery, Library, and details loading for faster navigation.
• Fixed immediate library add, edit, and remove behavior, per-page Library filters, account isolation, and local database placement.
• Fixed crashes when removing anime from the Library editor and when closing MiruShin on macOS.

v2.9.1:

• Improved Google Drive Library Sync with more reliable cross-device restore.
• Added complete library checkpoints with metadata and artwork for faster setup on new devices.
• Improved sync integrity with safer atomic restores and validation.
• Library data can now restore and display before connected trackers finish loading.
• Fixed MyAnimeList fallback handling for manga.
• Improved metadata synchronization and overall Library Sync stability.

v2.9.0:

• Added a canonical local-first Anime and Manga Library with safe offline mutations, Library Log, undo, conflict protection, and per-account workspaces.
• Added independent bidirectional sync for AniList, MyAnimeList, and Shikimori with exact ID matching, provider snapshots, safer reconciliation, and richer metadata fallback.
• Added optional Google Drive Sync for libraries, playback progress, stream preferences, addons, accounts, API connections, Watch with Friends preferences, and per-workspace settings.
• Added all AniList score formats, including 100-point, decimal, 10-point, 5-star, and smiley scoring.
• Improved OAuth login flows across mobile, desktop, TV.

v2.8.9:

• Added instant local Library updates for add, edit, delete, progress, score, notes, and repeat actions.
• Added more reliable AniList, MAL, and Shikimori synchronization.
• Added offline change support with automatic synchronization after reconnecting.
• Fixed newly added anime not appearing until a manual refresh.
• Fixed completed anime remaining in Watching.
• Fixed incorrect episode progress, such as 13/12.
• Fixed changes being applied to the wrong anime after Library reordering.
• Removed unnecessary Library reloads and delayed UI updates.
• Improved favorite and score update consistency.

v2.8.8:

• Fixed missing next-episode countdowns when AniList libraries are merged with MAL fallback data.

v2.8.7:

• Improved Watch Order with theme-colored current-title highlighting, personal score, and favorite status.

v2.8.6:

• Fixed player sessions not terminating correctly and restored proper playback speed handling.
• Fixed expired airing schedules still appearing in the Library.
• Improved seeking controls by separating arrow tap and hold behavior.

v2.8.5:

• Fixed streams freezing during startup and playback unexpectedly resuming after being paused.
• Fixed playback-speed changes causing stalls or showing a speed that was not actually applied.

• Added accumulated seek-distance feedback when repeatedly using the left and right arrow keys.
• Improved the Library AniList outage notice with scrolling, MyAnimeList fallback status, dismissal, and correct spacing.

v2.8.2:

• Improved add-on import, export, and backup reliability across devices.
• Fixed add-on restoration so exported configurations retain required module data and settings.

v2.8.1:

• Fixed MAL and Shikimori fallback responses overriding AniList library status and progress after an AniList outage.
• AniList now remains canonical when selected as the primary tracker, while fallback snapshots stay available without reopening completed titles.
• Local changes made during an outage remain queued and sync to AniList first, then independently to connected MyAnimeList and Shikimori accounts.
• Prevented automatic playback progress from reopening completed titles or dropping rewatching status.
• Entry edits now sync only fields that actually changed, so score or notes edits cannot overwrite status or progress.

v2.8.0:

• Added MyAnimeList fallback for AniList outages across Board, Discovery, media details, Library, and Watch Order, with automatic return to AniList after recovery.
• Added local-first tracking: progress, favorites, status, score, notes, repeat count, and dates are saved locally and safely synchronized later.
• AniList, MAL, and Shikimori now synchronize independently using stable media identity, offline mutation queues, provider health tracking, and conflict resolution.
• Library filters, sorting, Watch, Edit, Play, and continue-watching now work with locally cached and MAL fallback data during AniList outages.
• Fixed AniList outage banner spacing in Library to match Board and Discovery.

• Video quality can differ between participants while the episode, module, server, and voiceover remain synchronized.

• Added a dedicated Buy Me a Coffee support card after Accounts in AniList Settings and below MiruShin updates in TMDB Settings.

v2.7.12:

• Fixed Security Check verification loops on macOS and iOS.
• Fixed content not loading after completing verification.
• Prevented duplicate Security Check windows from opening.
• Improved cookie persistence and browser session handling during verification.
• Fixed offline HLS playback on macOS.

v2.7.11:

• Improved AniList reliability with a 30-second timeout and one automatic retry before falling back to cached data.

v2.7.10:

• Added automatic anime Watch Order with full franchise discovery and a Main story only filter.
• Added AniList progress and bold, theme-colored status labels to Watch Order.
• Replaced Related Titles with a cleaner, transparent Watch Order list.
• Cached Anime Themes for the current session to prevent repeated loading.

v2.7.9:

• Added clean share links for AniList anime and manga and TMDB movies and TV shows.
• Improved link safety while keeping existing MiruShin links fully compatible.

v2.7.8:

• Added clearly labeled IMDb ratings to TMDB movie/series and matched AniList anime detail pages, displayed directly after the original score.
• Profile action cards now fit up to five per row on larger screens, with additional cards wrapping cleanly.

v2.7.7:

• Fixed Compact Cards appearing outside the row edges while scrolling, while preserving hover effects.
• Compact Cards are now disabled by default; existing saved preferences remain unchanged.

v2.7.6:

• Expanded the AniList Board with Favorites, Airing, Upcoming, Finished, Newest, and Recently Updated sections.
• Added adaptive pagination to Board and Discovery: compact rows load automatically, while wide grids offer Load More and fetch results based on screen size.
• Made compact cards the default and improved responsive layouts with up to eight columns.
• Polished poster clipping, gradients, hover animations, and button press effects.
• Reduced the media-details hero height and improved Board loading feedback.

v2.7.5:

• Added a Fanart.tv-powered Gallery to Media Details with 4K-first backgrounds, cached results, and an optional securely stored API key in Settings.
• Added a fullscreen Gallery viewer with original-resolution artwork, swipe and arrow navigation, zooming, and an image counter.

• Improved Discovery on large screens with responsive filter controls and up to eight poster columns while preserving compact mobile layouts.

v2.7.4:

• Added cross-platform MiruShin deep links for opening AniList and TMDB titles directly in the app.

• Opening an AniList or TMDB MiruShin link now automatically switches to the matching catalog.
• Watch with Friends default invites now use normal clickable HTTPS links, while existing mirushin:// invite links remain supported.
• Improved Self-hosted Relay invites with cleaner direct HTTPS links and browser landing pages for opening rooms in MiruShin.
• Added a Setup Guide button for Self-hosted Relay configuration, with English, Russian, and Japanese localization.
• Improved macOS fullscreen transitions so the player waits for the native fullscreen transition to actually finish before closing or opening the next episode.
• Improved timeline hover and drag handling, preventing seek previews and player controls from getting stuck after fullscreen or window-state changes.
• Improved progressive seek previews to prefer the later thumbnail when two cached frames are equally close to the selected position.
• Fixed backup exports not correctly including some saved list-based settings and filters on desktop platforms.

v2.7.3:

• Added cross-platform MiruShin deep links for opening AniList and TMDB titles directly in the app on Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, and iOS.
• Added shareable MiruShin links to media details, alongside the original AniList or TMDB page links.

• Opening an AniList or TMDB MiruShin link now automatically switches to the matching catalog.
• Watch with Friends default invites now use a normal clickable HTTPS link that opens the room in MiruShin, while existing mirushin:// invites remain supported.
• Improved Self-hosted Relay invites with clean HTTPS links using the relay address directly, without redundant relay or transport parameters.
• Added browser landing pages for Self-hosted Relay invites with an Open in MiruShin action.

v2.7.2:

• Added full MiruShin configuration backup and restore in Settings → Data & backup.
• Backups include app and player settings, saved page and library filters, viewing progress, per-title stream choices, Watch with Friends relay and trust settings, installed Sora add-ons, source cookies, and local source state.
• AniList, MyAnimeList, and Shikimori sessions, profiles, saved AniList accounts, user settings, access tokens, and avatar URLs are included, along with configured TMDB and TVDB credentials.

• Improved Watch with Friends so guests retain their local and tracker progress while episode navigation and auto-next remain controlled by the host.
• Prevented locked guests from triggering next-episode actions through automatic playback, player controls, keyboard shortcuts, or Picture-in-Picture.
• Improved Watch with Friends synchronization by ignoring implausible cross-device timestamp differences that could incorrectly advance playback.
• Reworked compact media detail pages with responsive poster and text scaling, improved forced-compact behavior, and better narrow-screen layouts.
• Improved the fullscreen poster and background viewer: single tap closes it, double tap resets zoom, and existing zoom, drag, Escape, and system-back controls remain supported.
• Added complete English, Russian, and Japanese localization for backup and restore controls, warnings, confirmations, results, and errors.

v2.7.1:

• Added an option to enable or disable seek previews in Player Settings.
• Improved Watch with Friends with copyable invite links and additional localized room, connection, and relay controls.
• Posters can now be opened and viewed fullscreen from media details.
• Background images can now be opened and viewed fullscreen from media details.

v2.7.0:

• Added Self-hosted Relay support for Watch with Friends as an alternative when the default peer-to-peer connection does not work.
• Self-hosted rooms support one host and multiple guests at the same time.
• Added relay configuration and connection testing directly in Watch with Friends settings.
• Guests can join self-hosted rooms through invite links without manually configuring the relay.

• Added a complete open-source Cloudflare relay implementation that users can deploy and host themselves.
• The relay only handles Watch with Friends synchronization and never proxies video or audio streams.

v2.6.9:

• MiruShin now remembers your selected server and quality for each title and restores them automatically.
• Next episodes are prepared in the background for faster, smoother auto-next transitions.
• Added cache retention settings for metadata and artwork, with options from 1 week to never expire.
• Improved cache management so artwork and metadata share the configured cache size more efficiently.
• Watch with Friends hosts can now allow guests to change streams during a watch party.
• Guests can see which playback controls they have permission to use.

v2.6.8:

• Added progressive seek previews for online videos.
• Previews generate across the entire timeline in multiple refinement passes.
• The closest available preview appears immediately and improves as more frames generate.
• Generation continues in the background while the player is open.
• Choose between Progressive timeline (default) and On demand in Player Settings.
• Offline seek previews remain unchanged.

v2.6.7:

• Fixed Cloudflare security verification getting stuck in a refresh loop.
• Fixed source parsing starting before verification was complete.
• Removed duplicate WebView navigation events on Windows.
• Improved Cloudflare reliability across Windows, Android, iOS, and macOS.

v2.6.6:

• Added seek thumbnail previews for faster and more accurate timeline navigation.
• Improved timeline hover and seek behavior without moving the real playback position.

• Auto-next now always starts the next episode from 00:00 while manual episode selection still resumes saved progress.
• Fixed auto-next failing after returning to and rewatching a previous episode.
• Fixed episodes occasionally getting stuck at the end instead of advancing.
• Added stricter end-of-episode detection to prevent premature auto-next.
• Fixed manual seeking occasionally jumping back to the previous playback position.
• Improved FVP/MDK handling of stale end-of-stream events during and after seeking.
• Improved playback recovery for premature or inconsistent stream EOF states.
• Fixed fullscreen state being incorrectly carried to the next episode on desktop.
• Fullscreen transitions now follow the player's actual current fullscreen state.
• Improved next-episode stream resolution and retry handling.
• Episode selection now remains visible while the next stream is being resolved.
• Improved offline episode continuation and auto-delete reliability.
• Added safer playback generation tracking to prevent stale callbacks and duplicate episode transitions.
• Added 2.25x and 2.75x playback speed options.
• Improved native PiP completion and progress handling.
• iOS Home Indicator now stays auto-hidden across player navigation and auto-next transitions.
• Various playback stability improvements, race-condition fixes, and regression tests.

v2.6.5:

• Fixed Sora/Cloudflare security checks not completing on Android, iOS, and macOS.
• Fixed protected requests failing after verification by keeping them in the verified browser session.
• Fixed redirected requests losing their original endpoint path and query.

v2.6.4:

• Fixed Sora/Cloudflare security checks not completing on Android, iOS, and macOS.
• Fixed Windows crashes when starting Sora/Cloudflare security checks.
• Fixed protected-source parsing across supported platforms.

v2.6.3:

• Fixed protected-source parsing across Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows.

v2.6.2:

• Fixed Sora/Cloudflare security checks crashing after completion on Windows.
• Fixed browser session and cookie handling across supported platforms.

v2.6.1:

• Fixed Sora/Cloudflare security checks crashing after completion on Windows.
• Fixed browser session and cookie handling across supported platforms.

v2.6.0:

• Fixed Sora and Cloudflare challenge handling on Windows.
• Improved playback reliability with smarter stream fallbacks and DASH-to-HLS support.

• Added faster, more resilient catalog loading with metadata caching.
• Hidden AniList account and tracker connections while using the TMDB catalog.

v2.5.0:

• Fixed offline playback occasionally freezing around 7 seconds with automatic stall recovery.
• Randomized the Board hero from the top 20 anime.
• Improved AniList profile action buttons with a compact mobile layout.
• Added the Z keyboard shortcut for player zoom.
• Added a persistent option to enable or disable horizontal swipe seeking.
• Improved mobile volume behavior and disabled vertical swipe volume gestures on all devices.
• Redesigned and repositioned Watch, Trailer, and Edit buttons for responsive layouts.
• Fixed an AniList details overflow affecting popularity and favorites on narrow screens.

v2.4.4:

• Fixed the blank-window startup crash.

v2.4.3:

• Improved airing notification reliability when platform services are unavailable.
• Improved playback and external-link diagnostic logging.
• Reorganized internal code for clearer feature boundaries and easier maintenance.
• Improved automated testing across catalog, widget, Sora, and Worker components.

• General stability and maintenance improvements.

v2.4.2:

• Improved play/pause responsiveness and playback resume stability.

• Choose whether airing notifications include all eligible titles or only Watching/Rewatching.
• Removed the AniList Profile Feed and Reviews sections.

v2.4.1:

• Added anime opening and ending themes to anime detail pages.
• Fixed playback time jumping backward after seeking or skipping an opening or ending.
• Fixed Skip and Undo buttons appearing at the same time while buffering.

v2.4.0:

• Expanded Russian and Japanese translations across filters, settings, profiles, libraries, and media details.
• Localized player and trailer controls, along with AniList entry labels.
• When Russian (Shikimori) is selected, Shikimori YouTube trailers now prioritize Озвучка, followed by Субтитры.

v2.3.0:

• Added much better filters in Discovery, Library, and Source Modules.
• Filters now support include and exclude actions.
• Added much better filters in Discovery, Library, and Source Modules.

• Added AniList source/origin filters, adult content filter, licensing filter, and improved tag browsing/search.
• Improved Library filters with sorting/grouped tags and extra metadata filters.

• Added ASS/SSA subtitle parsing support.
• Improved player stability when streams fail to load or internet is weak.
• Made seeking more reliable so the player position and progress UI stay in sync.
• Fixed player controls sometimes not hiding properly on mobile/iOS.
• Improved keyboard shortcut handling in the player.
• Improved Skip OP/ED button visibility so it follows the player UI correctly.

v2.2.0:

• Watch with Friend: watch any episode in sync with a friend over a peer-to-peer connection.
• Create a room, share the 6-character code or QR, and playback stays locked together automatically.
• Host playback actions like play, pause, seek, and speed changes are instantly mirrored to the guest with drift correction.
• The host can optionally allow the guest to control playback, seek, or change speed.
• The guest resolves the stream source locally, so video is not routed through a server and quality is unaffected.
• Auto-reconnect after brief network drops, so the party can resume without rejoining.

v2.0.2:

• Added left-edge swipe-back gesture support on mobile.

v2.0.0:

• Added Cloudflare verification support: when required, a webview opens for captcha verification, then continues automatically after verification is complete.

• Improved subtitle parsing, including more accurate language detection and display.
• Improved the quality picker for better handling of streams with multiple quality options.

v1.9.0:

• Added MyAnimeList and Shikimori account connections alongside AniList.
• Sync your status, episode progress, and score across AniList, MyAnimeList, and Shikimori.
• Sign in securely from Settings -> Connections using OAuth.
• Choose your Library source from AniList, MyAnimeList, or Shikimori.
• Offline updates are now queued and synced automatically when you are back online.
• Added optional custom API credentials for MyAnimeList and Shikimori.
• Your tokens are stored securely on your device.

v1.8.1:

• Fixed auto next episode and watched progress triggering too early on unstable or reloaded streams.
• Next episode button now counts down 5 to 1, then closes the player if you don't continue.
• Next episode button shows shortly after the episode ends instead of instantly.
• Added a keyboard shortcuts and touch gestures panel in player settings.
• New keys: C toggles subtitles, P enters Picture in Picture, V skips intro/outro or goes to next episode.

v1.8.0:

• Added an Episodes button in the player so you can jump to any episode directly.
• Improved player controls so labels switch to icons earlier and never feel cramped.

• Now Playing now shows the real AniList/TMDB title in your selected language, with smart fallback support.
• Fixed TMDB library progress showing 0% instead of the correct watch percentage.
• Settings now adapt to your selected catalog mode.
• TMDB mode now hides AniList options and accounts.
• AniList mode now hides TMDB-specific options.
• Removed the redundant TMDB enable toggle.
• Added a new Compact cards toggle for Board cards.

• Removed unused settings: Poster card style, Subtitle preferred language, and Region/country.
• Removed the redundant Discovery status bar for a cleaner browsing experience.

v1.7.3:

• Added an MSI installer for Windows (.msi), alongside the existing setup .exe and portable .zip. The MSI lets you choose a per-user or all-users install.
• Fixed Android TV D-pad navigation on the Home and Discovery screens: focus no longer skips the movie posters and jumps straight to the "see more" / "Load more" button, so you can now reach and select every poster.

v1.7.2:

• Fixed playback speed not being restored after the player restarts.
• Added a short delay before auto-playing the next episode after the current stream finishes.

v1.7.1:

• Added Clear All and Apply buttons to the source filter.
• Updated several localization strings.

v1.7.0:

• Added a new Sources page. You can open it from the Sources button on the Addons page.
• You can now add your own catalog by pasting a catalog URL, for example example.com/modules.json.
• You can open a source, browse its addons, and install them into your library with one tap.
• Addons that are already installed are now clearly marked.
• Added search by addon name, author, language, and type.
• Added filters for multiple languages and types at the same time, for example Russian + English or anime + movies.

• You can now refresh, rename, copy the URL, or remove a source.
• Removing a source will not remove your installed addons.

v1.6.4:

• Added support for adding addons by addon ID.

v1.6.3:

• TMDB season picker now shows the real number of seasons from the addon.
• Fixed watch progress not tracking for TMDB episodes in the local library, including across auto-next season changes.

v1.6.2:

• Fixed auto-next episode and watch progress for auto-played episodes.

• Previously, when an episode started automatically, watch progress was not saved and the next episode did not play correctly.
• Now every episode saves progress, marks itself as watched at 85%, and reliably continues to the next episode.

v1.6.0:

• Android TV support with Leanback launcher/banner, TV-aware navigation, focus rings, and d-pad-friendly cards.
• Player remote fixes: OK play/pause, paused UI focus navigation, Settings/Quality/Episodes/Subtitles reachable by d-pad, sliders no longer trap focus, Back hides chrome first.
• Android TV WebView cursor improvements: smaller/smoother cursor, native tap fallback, better keyboard/textbox handling, and cursor support for YouTube trailers.
• AniList editor improvements from TV: hold OK on media cards opens entry edit actions where supported.
• Library/search/addon/settings text fields improved for d-pad escape.
• Playback fixes including seek/d-pad fixes, PiP handling fixes, iOS PiP fix, and player back-button fixes.
• AniList and Shikimori metadata/library fixes.

v1.5.0:

• Improved auto-next episode, mark as watched, and AniList sync.
• Fixed progress on finished streams, even when the stream jumps back to 0:00.
• Fixed player controls and mouse cursor not hiding after auto-next.
• Fixed buffering spinner sometimes staying visible after playback resumes.
• AniList now marks anime as Completed when you finish the last known episode.
• Fixed Trailer button, now it appears correctly on all devices.
• Moved Auto AniList progress setting, now it only shows in the AniList catalog.
• Fixed settings not saving after app restart.
• Poster card style and compact mode are now remembered.

v1.4.4:

• Added a built-in TMDB key, so MiruShin works out of the box.
• TMDB metadata now loads on first launch without setup.
• Added a Use custom API key option in Settings -> API Connections.
• You can still use your own TMDB Read Access Token if needed.
• TMDB metadata is now enabled by default.

v1.4.3:

• Improved video playback reliability.
• Fixed some streams not playing when proxy playback failed.
• The player now automatically tries another playback method when needed.

v1.4.2:

• Episodes in the TMDB Catalog are now sorted by season.

v1.4.1:

• Fixed WebView support on Windows. YouTube trailers now play correctly on Windows.

v1.4.0:

• Added trailer support for AniList and TMDB catalogs. The trailer button is shown only when a trailer is available.

v1.3.8:

• Improved the anime and manga detail pages with a cleaner and more polished layout.
• Improved the Edit button design and placement.
• AniList cards now always open the Edit page in AniList mode.
• Fixed Auto-Next so it now keeps the server selected inside the player. The next episode will resolve using the chosen server instead of falling back to the old or default one.

v1.3.7:

• Added pinch-out gesture support in the player to switch to Zoom mode.
• Added pinch-in gesture support to switch back to Normal mode.
• Improved the left sidebar behavior, so it now switches states earlier and feels more responsive.
• Reduced the height of the top and bottom black fog effects in the player UI for a cleaner viewing experience.
• Fixed player initialization: the video now repaints immediately instead of waiting for mouse movement to trigger a rebuild.

v1.3.6:

• Added a custom accent color picker.
• Removed unused options from Settings for a cleaner experience.

v1.3.5:

• Added a floating popup notification for new app updates.
• Improved mobile auto-next playback. The next episode now opens immediately in fullscreen player mode for a smoother watching experience.

• Fixed slow Choose Episode loading for custom/addon sources.
• Episodes from the addon now appear first, using the addon’s own episode name and poster when available.
• AniList/AniZip episode titles and thumbnails now load lazily only after the episode list is already shown.
• Improved support for custom Sora episode formats, including grouped episode lists and chapter-style APIs.
• Reduced stale search work when switching from Find Sources to Choose Episode.
• Auto-next now fetches the latest addon episode list instead of relying on old cached episode data.

v1.3.4:

• Added animated hover backgrounds for Windows PiP buttons, making the controls feel smoother and more responsive.

v1.3.3:

• Smarter Escape key in the player.
• Infinite scroll on AniList Favourites.

apps.subtitle: Modern cross-platform Plex client
apps.localizedDescription:
About:

Flixor is a modern, cross-platform Plex client that brings a Netflix-like experience to your media library. Browse beautiful rows, see rich metadata with ratings from multiple sources, and enjoy powerful playback on any device.

Core Experience:

• Netflix-style UI - Continue Watching, Trending, Collections, Watchlist, and more.
• Rich metadata - Trailers, cast info, tech badges (4K/HDR/Atmos/DTS-X).
• Smart search - Search across Plex and TMDB with intelligent filtering.
• Ultra-fast grids - Optimized for libraries with thousands of items.
• Cross-platform sync - Watch progress syncs across all your devices.

Playback:

• Web: Built-in DASH/HLS player with Picture-in-Picture and subtitle support.
• macOS: MPV-powered with HDR, Dolby Vision, and advanced audio passthrough.
• Mobile: Native players with background playback and streaming quality options.

versions.localizedDescription:
This is a Major announcement. Had a super busy last month so release got delayed then what I had in my mind initially.

Official site is https://flixor.xyz, you can sign up to get updates via email there.

TvOS Alpha::

TestFlight link is ACTIVE this is the link: https://testflight.apple.com/join/hwRWYxBs

Keep an eye on the testflight when apple completes it review it will get active.

This first ALPHA release of TvOS you will see many UI and Performance bugs. Not all features from Mobile and MacOS are there in this TvOS release.

Please test everything, and report issue you are seeing in detail with screenshots preferably on Github issues.

Mobile and MacOS now has Stremio Addon support, you primary login of Plex is still required. The support is experimental please post and share how things are working on your end for this feature.

tvOS Alpha.

• The Apple TV app now has a real usable foundation with Home, Shows, Movies, My List, Search, New & Popular, and Settings.
• The details experience got a major parity pass with richer layouts, collapsible headers, logo art, better metadata grids, technical badges, and trailer support.
• Playback is now wired up with MPV support and in-player controls for quality, audio, and subtitles.
• We also spent a lot of time on the stuff that matters on tvOS: smoother focus behavior, better scrolling performance, GPU/rendering cleanup, cache crash fixes, and better image handling.
• Settings and service integrations are now connected for Plex, TMDB, MDBList, Overseerr, and Trakt sync/scrobbling.

It’s still alpha, but it’s finally at the point where real Apple TV testing makes sense instead of it feeling like a prototype.

Other work that landed in the same stretch.

• Stremio support is now in mobile and macOS, including addon management, source selection, resume handling, and subtitle provider support.

• Mobile customization also improved: you can hide the My List tab, toggle Plex genre rows, and the default details layout is more consistent.
• We fixed a bunch of mobile rough edges too, especially around non-English titles/backdrops, Trakt episode navigation, scrobbling, and Android performance.
• macOS picked up Stremio support, a Recently Added row, fresher Continue Watching updates, subtitle settings, HDR color improvements, and general UI/navigation cleanup.

For next three months no new features will be added. Work and updates will focus primarily on TvOS feature parity, fixing bugs and improving performance on all platforms.

apps.subtitle: Paper Comic Reader — a focused iOS comic reader
apps.localizedDescription:
Paper Comic Reader:

A lean, native comic reader for iPhone and iPad that makes pages read like ink on paper instead of a backlit screen. Download on the App Store · Landing page.

Paper Comic Reader opens CBZ archives, keeps a library with reading progress and bookmarks, and can render every page with a realistic paper effect (ported from the Simple Comic fork) — a warm tonal remap plus a fine paper grain, so pages read like they were printed.

Built with SwiftUI and a UIKit reader core, Core Image and Metal for the paper effect. Everything runs on-device: no accounts, no network requests, no tracking or analytics.

Install:

On the App Store (easiest): Paper Comic Reader on the App Store — signed, free, auto-updating, no sideload tooling. This is the recommended way to install.

iOS can't install this directly — see the README for how to sideload it and re-sign it with your own Apple ID.

• Group Settings by appearance, page turning, portrait and landscape.
• Read portrait as one page strip and hand over to spreads on rotation.
• Add a portrait strip reading mode.
